---
title: "Class Overview"
---

This page lists the main classes implemented in the `spatial_guidance` package.
For brevity only the most important attributes are mentioned. See the
[Diagrams](diagrams.qmd) page for relationships.

## `data_contracts`

- **`DataModel`** – base class with helpers for JSON schema generation and
  structured output parsing.
- **`RawAABBDetSeg`** – raw bounding box result returned by the Gemini model.
- **`AABBDetection`** – processed detection with depth, rotation and mask data.
- **`AABBDetections`** – collection of `AABBDetection` objects with
  convenience methods.
- **`RawOBBDetection`** – raw oriented 3‑D box output from Gemini.
- **`OBBDetection`** – processed 3‑D bounding box with vertex computations.
- **`OBBDetections`** – container holding many `OBBDetection` instances.
- **`PipelineIn`** – input specification for dataset pipeline stages.
- **`DatasetOut`** – RGB‑D frame with camera pose and intrinsics.

## `data_handling`

- **`StrayScannerPaths`** – resolves dataset file paths and validates the
  dataset directory.
- **`StrayScannerDataParser`** – loads images, depth maps and poses from a
  StrayScanner dataset.
- **`StrayDataset`** – high level dataset that returns `DatasetOut` items with
  optional pose scaling.

## `live_agent`

- **`AskCmd`, `AudioCmd`, `SetFrameCmd`** – command messages sent to the agent
  thread.
- **`TextEvt`, `AudioEvt`, `DetectionsEvt`, `ErrorEvt`** – event messages
  produced by the agent.
- **`_ExecAPI`** – restricted API exposed to code execution snippets.
- **`GeminiLiveAgent`** – coordinates frame streaming, Gemini interaction and
  tool responses using an actor pattern.
- **`GeminiLiveAgentConfig`** – Pydantic configuration for the live agent.
- **`DirectionalStyle`, `DistanceStyle`, `GenState`, `InteractionMode`,
  `OperationalMode`** – enums controlling response style and operation modes.

## `scene_understanding`

- **`GeminiAABBDetSeg`**, **`GeminiAABBDetSegConfig`** – 2‑D detection and
  segmentation using Gemini with structured output.
- **`GeminiOBBDet`**, **`GeminiOBBDetConfig`** – 3‑D oriented box detection.
- **`GeminiSceneDescriptor`**, **`GeminiSceneDescriptorConfig`** – generates a
  full scene description from RGB‑D data and detections.
